# `new`, then `check`, work together. (from internal_error::cli_new_check_and_run_work_together)
exec metagente new hello
stdout 'Created hello\.ag'
stdout 'Created metagente\.toml'
stdout 'Try it: metagente run hello\.ag greet name=World'
exists hello.ag
exists metagente.toml

! exec metagente new hello
stderr 'already exists'

exec metagente check hello.ag
stdout 'No problems found in hello\.ag \(1 agent\)\.'
! stderr .
